name: Cut-Throat Creek
description: On leaving the safe room, the Survivors find themselves in a fenced woodland area with a storage building to the left. In order to continue Survivors use a radio in the storage building to call for help. They must then activate a large hangar door which triggers a never-ending Horde. From this point on they must fight their way against the pressure of these enemies to a rescue helicopter hovering over a forest recreation facility once occupied, but now abandoned, by CEDA.
